text_block_list.text:
One morning during the summer training camp,
I spotted Mejiro Ryan walking over while stretching.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Good morning, Trainer!
Looking forward to working with you today!
choice_data_list: Full of energy today as well!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I've been in top shape lately! Must be thanks to you, Trainer!
—Oh, morning assembly is about to start!

The horsegirls gathered in the training camp lobby one after another.
The Trainer Representative stepped forward.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Representative
text_block_list.text:
As we reach the midpoint of summer camp, many of you are feeling the fruits of your training.
I'm sure plenty of students want to test their mettle. Therefore—

text_block_list.name: Trainer Representative
text_block_list.text:
We will be holding a mock race on the final day of camp!
If you wish to participate, have your Trainer submit your entry!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Representative
text_block_list.text: The first horsegirl to enter is—Oguri Cap!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: A chance to run against Oguri-san in a mock race...?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
To be honest, I've always looked up to her.
Ever since she transferred here.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
She doesn't come from a prestigious background, yet she commands everyone's attention purely through raw skill.
In other words... she's the real deal.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer.
I want to run against Oguri-san in the mock race.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Thanks! I'll give it everything I've got!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
So, right to business...
Please train me to beat Oguri-san!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Oguri-san's greatest weapon is her razor-sharp late surge...
If anything, I'm pretty much the same type of runner.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: In that case, what kind of strategy should we go with?
There are two potential strategies.

Either hone her late surge even further for a head-on clash,
or shake things up with an unexpected front-running tactic.

When I asked her to choose, Mejiro Ryan thought it over
carefully before looking back up.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: ...I want to try a front-running strategy!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Normally, I'd go for a head-to-head showdown, but...
right now, I want to broaden my horizons!

Mejiro Ryan's reply was more earnest than ever.
Her burning passion for this race was palpable.
choice_data_list: Alright, let's train for a front-running strategy!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Count on me!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
To run from the front, I need to make sure my stamina doesn't run out
so I can sustain an unyielding pace.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I can't let something like this wear me down!
Roar, my big muscle groups!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: *pant*... *gasp*... *whew*...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Hah...! Yes, sir!
Thank you for the guidance!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
We don't have much time left, but still...
...Huh?

Just then, a gust of wind whipped past right beside us.
In the corner of my eye, I thought I caught a brief glimpse of a white silhouette...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Was that just now...?! Was that Oguri-san?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that gleaming gray coat, there's no mistaking it!
That sprint... Could she really be giving it her absolute all in training...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
...I'm so glad.
That means I'll get to race Oguri-san when she's dead serious.

As Mejiro Ryan smiled with deep emotion, chatter
from other horsegirls drifted into earshot.

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, was that Oguri-senpai just now?
Isn't she in a bit of a slump?

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text: Must be why she's pushing herself so desperately.

A slump...
If she's in that state, a front-running strategy might actually work.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
It was only for a split second, but... the look on Oguri-san's face was completely serious.
So much so that she didn't look like someone in a slump at all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
She's set on getting in peak condition by the race...
You can't run like that unless you truly believe in yourself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Believing in oneself...
If that's the case, then I...

The day of the mock race arrived.
True to expectations, Oguri Cap showed up in pristine form.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Representative
text_block_list.text:
Racers, into your assigned gates!
...Start!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Oguri-san...!
I want to... surpass the idol I've always looked up to!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
Oguri-senpai's in a great position! And Ryan is right on her tail!
This final-stretch showdown is gonna be amazing...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: This is who I am... This is Mejiro Ryan's running!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text:
Oguri-senpai broke through! Ryan's closing in too!
She's stretching out, she's pulling up! It's a head-to-head battle!!
Who will claim victory—which one will it be—?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Heheh... I lost.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry for suddenly asking to change our strategy...
I just couldn't resist going toe-to-toe with Oguri-san at her absolute best.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Yes! It was a truly blazing duel...
And I was so close, just a neck's length away from reaching her...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I'm frustrated, but I'm not feeling down.
Because I didn't run away from myself, I feel confident now!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
...I'm going to get even stronger.
Strong enough that I won't lose to Oguri Cap, or to Mejiro McQueen.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Trainer...
Will you keep cheering for me, through thick and thin?

Mejiro Ryan gave me her brightest smile.
And I renewed my resolve once more to run alongside her all the way.
